fields.description: console = store the code in the Error Log and skip sending. Switch to whatsapp/sms once provider credentials are configured. The code is never returned by the API in any mode.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: When on, every console-mode OTP uses the fixed code below (handy for app development). When off, a random 6-digit code is generated. Ignored unless provider is console.
fields.label: Use Fixed Dev Code

fields.description: How long a code is valid for, in seconds. API_SPEC 4.1 asks for 5 minutes.
fields.label: OTP TTL (seconds)

fields.description: Lock the code after this many wrong tries.
fields.label: Max Attempts

fields.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive OTP requests for the same phone. Sent to the client as resend_after_seconds, which drives its countdown.
fields.label: Resend Interval (seconds)

fields.description: Maximum OTP requests per phone per hour. API_SPEC 4.1 asks for 3 per 15 minutes.
fields.label: Hourly Limit

fields.description: Which WhatsApp backend to send through. meta = official Cloud API. ultramsg / openwaapi send free-form text.
fields.label: WhatsApp Backend

fields.description: Meta Cloud API phone_number_id from the WhatsApp app.
fields.label: WhatsApp Phone Number ID

fields.description: Meta Cloud API access token. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: WhatsApp Access Token

fields.description: Graph API version to call.
fields.label: WhatsApp API Version

fields.description: Approved template name used for OTP messages.
fields.label: WhatsApp OTP Template Name

fields.description: Template language code.
fields.label: WhatsApp OTP Template Language

fields.description: UltraMsg instance id, e.g. instance182401.
fields.label: UltraMsg Instance ID

fields.description: UltraMsg instance token. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: UltraMsg Token

fields.description: Message priority (1-10).
fields.label: UltraMsg Priority

fields.description: OpenWA API base URL. You can paste it with or without the trailing /api.
fields.label: OpenWA API Base URL

fields.description: OpenWA API key. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: OpenWA API Key

fields.description: Connected OpenWA session ID/name used to send OTPs.
fields.label: OpenWA Session ID

fields.description: twilio = Twilio REST API. generic = any gateway that accepts a GET/POST with the phone and message as query parameters.
fields.label: SMS Backend

fields.description: Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Twilio Auth Token

fields.description: The sender number, in E.164.
fields.label: Twilio From Number

fields.description: Full gateway URL. {phone} and {message} placeholders are substituted.
fields.label: SMS Gateway URL

fields.description: Sent as the api_key parameter. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: SMS Gateway API Key

fields.description: Access token lifetime. API_SPEC 4.2 asks for 60 minutes.
fields.label: Access Token TTL (minutes)

fields.description: Refresh token lifetime. API_SPEC 4.2 asks for 60 days. Refresh tokens rotate on use.
fields.label: Refresh Token TTL (days)

fields.description: Business rules left open by API_SPEC Appendix C. Changing a value here changes it everywhere.
fields.label: Commerce

fields.description: Appendix C q5. Refundable deposit per bottle, in rupees, when a bottle has no deposit of its own.
fields.label: Default Deposit (Rs)

fields.description: Appendix C q2. Percent of gross sales taken as commission on the weekly payout. Deposits are excluded from the base.
fields.label: Commission Rate (%)

fields.description: A bottle at or below this filled stock raises the seller's low-stock label and hourly alert.
fields.label: Low Stock Threshold

fields.description: API_SPEC 6.7. A dispute left unsettled this long is escalated and the seller's rating is protected.
fields.label: Dispute Window (hours)

fields.description: FCM server key for push (API_SPEC 9). Leave blank to disable push - the in-app feed and sockets still work. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: FCM Server Key
